key_insight: This review finds that deep learning offers promising 2D-to-3D image alignment, but uncertainty estimation and temporal modelling remain key gaps for clinical readiness.
clinical_relevance: Aligning preoperative 3D volumes with real-time 2D images could support intraoperative guidance.
method: Reviews deep learning pipeline designs and architectures for 2D-to-3D registration.
Examines domain adaptation strategies and quantitative performance metrics.
Identifies opportunities for temporal memory and foundation-model representations.
evidence_signal: Among 41 reviewed studies, 23 used direct regression and 18 used iterative pipelines, with research concentrated on X-ray-to-CT registration.
watch_item: The reported absence of per-case uncertainty estimation limits assessment of alignment reliability in individual cases.
paper_title: A thorough review on Deep Learning approaches to 2D-to-3D Registration in Medical Imaging
